classification.difficultyReason: Infer the square's side and the white region's width, calculate areas and simplify their ratio.

content.prompt:
The shaded part of the rectangle is a square.

What is the ratio of the white area to the shaded area, in simplest form?

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle, white region on the left and shaded square at the right. Double-headed arrows label height 4 cm and total length 24 cm.
spec.mathematics: The rectangle has dimensions 24 cm by 4 cm. The right-hand square has side 4 cm. Its left boundary is one sixth of the total length from the right end. Restrained light blue shading identifies the square required by the question.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are visible; no derived lengths, areas or ratio are included.

answer.worked:
The square has side $4\text{ cm}$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{White width}&=24-4\\&=20\text{ cm}\\\text{White area}&=20\times4\\&=80\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Shaded area}&=4\times4\\&=16\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$

Divide both areas by their HCF, $16$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{White area}:\text{shaded area}&=80:16\\&=5:1\end{align*}$$
